also: make the sign of the cross

evidence: Liv. 21.58.2: ad prīma ac dubia signa vēris
Quint. 1.3.1: ingeniī signum in parvīs praecipuum memoria est
terms.comment: Of a mark, a token, an omen and a signal: signum dare, to give the signal. The sign of the cross is signum crucis; to cross oneself, sē signāre (M-O s.v. cross oneself).
A sign from which something else is understood, as a crime from blood (Quint.).

terms.gloss: a nod, a sign with the head
evidence: Ov. Tr. 2.453: digitīsque saepe est nūtūque locūtus (Lewis & Short)
Phaedr. App. 28.7–10: dexteram dēmōnstrat nūtū partem
terms.comment: Of signing with the head instead of speaking.

phrases.latin: ad prīma ac dubia signa vēris
phrases.english: at the first, uncertain signs of spring

phrases.latin: ingeniī signum in parvīs praecipuum memoria est
phrases.english: in little children the chief sign of talent is memory

phrases.latin: fac, cum vocante somnō castum petis cubīle, frontem locumque cordis crucis figūra signet
phrases.english: when sleep calls and you seek your chaste bed, let the sign of the cross mark your forehead and your heart

phrases.latin: pollice signum crucis pingō in fronte
phrases.english: I make the sign of the cross on my forehead with my thumb (a boy describing his morning)
